blueprint.coverage_deficit_addressed: Celiac disease — Tissue transglutaminase deamidates selected glutamine residues in gluten peptides to glutamate, increasing their negative charge and affinity for disease-associated HLA-DQ2/DQ8 molecules. Presentation of these peptides to CD4+ T cells drives mucosal inflammation and villous injury.

blueprint.exact_outline_path_verification: Pending direct comparison with official outline; not certified by this screen.

distractor_explanations.A: Incorrect. Proteasomal proteolysis generates many peptides for MHC class I presentation. This is not the gluten-deamidating action of tissue transglutaminase.
distractor_explanations.B: Incorrect. TAP transports peptides into the endoplasmic reticulum for MHC class I loading. Tissue transglutaminase instead modifies selected glutamine side chains in gluten peptides.
distractor_explanations.C: Incorrect. HLA-DM promotes peptide exchange on MHC class II molecules. Peptide loading is distinct from the covalent deamidation performed by tissue transglutaminase.
distractor_explanations.D: Correct. Tissue transglutaminase converts selected glutamine residues in gluten peptides to negatively charged glutamate. These deamidated peptides bind HLA-DQ2 or HLA-DQ8 more avidly and are presented to CD4+ T cells, generating the inflammatory response that damages small-intestinal villi.
distractor_explanations.E: Incorrect. B7 molecules, CD80 and CD86, provide costimulation through CD28. Tissue transglutaminase promotes recognition by modifying the gluten peptide, not by serving as this costimulatory ligand.

explanation.educational_objective: Explain how tissue transglutaminase-mediated deamidation of gluten enhances HLA-DQ2/DQ8 presentation and T-cell activation in celiac disease.
explanation.key_explanation: Tissue transglutaminase converts selected glutamine residues in gluten peptides to negatively charged glutamate. These deamidated peptides bind HLA-DQ2 or HLA-DQ8 more avidly and are presented to CD4+ T cells, generating the inflammatory response that damages small-intestinal villi.

item.lead_in: How does tissue transglutaminase most directly promote the pathogenic T-cell response in this disease?

options.A: By proteolytically generating cytosolic peptides for presentation by MHC class I molecules
options.B: By transporting cytosolic peptides into the endoplasmic reticulum for MHC class I loading
options.C: By catalyzing the exchange of CLIP for antigenic peptides on MHC class II molecules

distractor_explanations.A: Incorrect. An as-treated analysis breaks the original randomized comparison because treatment received can be influenced by prognosis and other post-randomization factors.

The intention-to-treat principle analyzes participants according to their randomized assignment, even if they discontinue, switch, or incompletely adhere to treatment. This preserves the causal interpretation of randomization for the effect of treatment assignment. Per-protocol and as-treated analyses answer different questions and can be biased by post-randomization selection.

distractor_explanations.A: Incorrect. Type II collagen is abundant in cartilage and is encoded by COL2A1, not COL1A1.
distractor_explanations.B: Correct. COL1A1 and COL1A2 encode the alpha chains of type I collagen, the principal fibrillar collagen of bone, dermis, tendon, and other connective tissues. distractor_explanations.C: Incorrect. Type III collagen is encoded by COL3A1 and is prominently affected in vascular Ehlers-Danlos syndrome.
distractor_explanations.D: Incorrect. Type IV collagen forms basement-membrane networks and is distinct from fibrillar type I collagen.
distractor_explanations.E: Incorrect. Fibrillin-1 is affected in Marfan syndrome and is not a collagen chain.

blueprint.coverage_deficit_addressed: Autoimmune hepatitis — Autoimmune hepatitis is an immune-mediated inflammatory liver disease associated with loss of immune tolerance. distractor_explanations.A: Incorrect. Primary biliary cholangitis is a cholestatic small-duct disease classically associated with antimitochondrial antibodies rather than a plasma-cell-rich hepatocellular interface pattern.
distractor_explanations.B: Incorrect. Primary sclerosing cholangitis is a cholangiopathy characterized by multifocal biliary stricturing and is not defined by ANA/ASMA-associated interface hepatitis.
distractor_explanations.C: Correct. The combination of hepatocellular injury, elevated IgG, ANA/anti-smooth-muscle antibodies, exclusion of viral hepatitis, and plasma-cell-rich interface hepatitis strongly supports autoimmune hepatitis. distractor_explanations.A: Incorrect. Histamine is central to mast-cell-mediated allergic angioedema and urticaria, which is not the mechanism of C1-inhibitor-deficient hereditary angioedema.
distractor_explanations.B: Incorrect. Cysteinyl leukotrienes can increase vascular permeability in allergic inflammation but are not the principal mediator of hereditary angioedema.
distractor_explanations.C: Correct. C1 inhibitor normally restrains plasma kallikrein and factor XIIa. Deficiency allows excess bradykinin generation, which increases vascular permeability and produces nonurticarial hereditary angioedema.
distractor_explanations.D: Incorrect. Serotonin is not the dominant mediator of C1-inhibitor-deficient angioedema.
distractor_explanations.E: Incorrect. Prostaglandin D2 is a mast-cell-derived mediator but does not explain the bradykinin-dependent inherited syndrome.

explanation.educational_objective: Recognize hereditary angioedema with C1-inhibitor deficiency as a bradykinin-mediated, not histamine-mediated, disorder.
explanation.key_explanation: C1 inhibitor normally restrains plasma kallikrein and factor XIIa. Deficiency allows excess bradykinin generation, which increases vascular permeability and produces nonurticarial hereditary angioedema.

item.difficulty_basis: Author estimate, not psychometric calibration: Familial nonurticarial edema plus SERPING1 identifies the bradykinin mechanism directly.
item.lead_in: Excess production of which mediator most directly causes the edema in this disorder?

item.tested_construct: C1-inhibitor deficiency fails to restrain the contact kallikrein-kinin system, causing excessive bradykinin production and episodic increases in vascular permeability without histamine-mediated urticaria.
item.vignette: A 17-year-old girl has recurrent episodes of nonpruritic swelling of the lips and hands and severe crampy abdominal pain. She has no urticaria. Her mother has similar episodes. Genetic testing identifies a pathogenic SERPING1 variant.
